name_basics.table_comment: Table containing basic information about people in IMDb

column_comments.name_basics_knownfortitles: titles the person is known for (array of tconsts)
column_comments.name_basics_nconst: alphanumeric unique identifier of the name/person (string)
column_comments.name_basics_primaryname: name by which the person is most often credited (string)
column_comments.name_basics_primaryprofession: the top-3 professions of the person (array of strings)

title_akas.table_comment: Table containing alternate titles for IMDb entries

column_comments.title_akas_attributes: Additional terms to describe this alternative title (array), not enumerated
column_comments.title_akas_ordering: a number to uniquely identify rows for a given titleId (integer)
column_comments.title_akas_region: the region for this version of the title (string)
column_comments.title_akas_titleid: a tconst (string, an alphanumeric unique identifier of the title)
column_comments.title_akas_types: Enumerated set of attributes for this alternative title (array). One or more of the following: "alternative", "dvd", "festival", "tv", "video", "working", "original", "imdbDisplay". New values may be added in the future without warning

title_basics.table_comment: Table containing basic information about IMDb titles

column_comments.title_basics_endyear: TV Series end year (YYYY). ‘\N’ for all other title types
column_comments.title_basics_genres: includes up to three genres associated with the title (string array)
column_comments.title_basics_primarytitle: the more popular title (string) (the title used by the filmmakers on promotional materials at the point of release)
column_comments.title_basics_runtimeminutes: primary runtime of the title (integer, in minutes)
column_comments.title_basics_startyear: represents the release year of a title (YYYY). In the case of TV Series, it is the series start year
column_comments.title_basics_tconst: alphanumeric unique identifier of the title (string)
column_comments.title_basics_titletype: the type/format of the title (string) (e.g. movie, short, tvseries, tvepisode, video, etc)

title_crew.table_comment: Table containing crew information for IMDb titles

column_comments.title_crew_directors: director(s) of the given title (array of nconsts)
column_comments.title_crew_tconst: alphanumeric unique identifier of the title (string)
column_comments.title_crew_writers: writer(s) of the given title (array of nconsts)

title_episode.table_comment: Table containing episode information for TV series in IMDb

column_comments.title_episode_episodenumber: episode number of the tconst in the TV series (integer)
column_comments.title_episode_parenttconst: alphanumeric identifier of the parent TV Series (string)
column_comments.title_episode_seasonnumber: season number the episode belongs to (integer)

title_principals.table_comment: Table containing principal cast and crew information for IMDb titles

column_comments.title_principals_category: the category of job that person was in (string)
column_comments.title_principals_characters: the name of the character played if applicable, else
column_comments.title_principals_job: the specific job title if applicable, else
column_comments.title_principals_nconst: alphanumeric unique identifier of the name/person (string)
column_comments.title_principals_ordering: a number to uniquely identify rows for a given titleId (integer)
column_comments.title_principals_tconst: alphanumeric unique identifier of the title (string)

title_ratings.table_comment: Table containing user ratings for IMDb titles

column_comments.title_ratings_averagerating: weighted average of all the individual user ratings (float)
column_comments.title_ratings_numvotes: number of votes the title has received (integer)
column_comments.title_ratings_tconst: alphanumeric unique identifier of the title (string)
